Surprise items is a format where a set of items are each sold at random — the buyer finds out which of the items they will receive live. You can see all available items in this format in the Items tab.

What To Expect?

Surprise Sets go through two main stages:

⏳ Filling + Running

The excitement begins! This is the time when you can purchase a surprise item. You can always see how many spots are left and what items have been sold.

✅ Completed

The sale is over. All of the available items have been sold and revealed, and the seller will ship to you as soon as they can.
